name: handoff
description: Write a focused Codex session handoff card, load it in the next session, and keep the plugin current with handoff-update.

interface.shortDescription: Carry concise handoff cards between Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Write a focused three-section session handoff card, automatically load it at the next session start, and update installed host integrations with one stable command.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $handoff to leave a concise handoff card for the next Codex session.
